 Harrison Ford and Calista Flockhart to Receive First Joint Award as Couple Is Selected for Icon Honors
 The pair will share the spotlight at the Women's Guild Cedars-Sinai's Stardust Ball at which Byron Allen will be celebrated with a trophy for his humanitarian work at the Beverly Wilshire on Nov. 18.

 Harrison Ford and Calista Flockhart will take a spin in the spotlight at the Stardust Ball, a fundraiser presented by Women’s Guild Cedars-Sinai at the Beverly Wilshire Hotel on Nov. 18. The moment will mark the couple’s first joint award and is coming their way to recognize their “extraordinary careers and longstanding commitment to philanthropy,” per the organization.
 Ford and Flockhart will be joined on the honoree program by media mogul Byron Allen , who will receive a humanitarian award for a “longstanding commitment to creating opportunity, expanding representation and using his platform to uplift underserved communities.”

 Ford has a long history of activism and supporting causes he cares about from environmental conservation to humanitarian service. He joined Conservation International’s board of directors in 1991, and has since become the org’s longest-serving member. Currently a vice chair, Ford received an inaugural E.O. Wilson Legacy Award for “transformative conservation leadership” from the organization. As a well-known pilot, Ford piloted search-and-rescue missions, transported medical professionals and supplies to rescue efforts in Haiti, and supported orgs like Operation Smile, Special Olympics and Wings of Hope.
 Flockhart meanwhile has a long history of supporting charitable and philanthropic initiatives with a focus on preventing violence against women and children, animal welfare and good health. She’s specifically pitched in by working with For Goodness Sakes, Peace Over Violence and the Violence Intervention Program.
 They’ve been together since around 2002, and maintained a low profile for much of their marriage. They’ve recently stepped out at high profile events in 2026 like the Lucas Museum of Narrative Art opening, the Emmy Awards, the Actor Awards and more. Ford currently stars in Shrinking on Apple TV while Flockhart recently starred in Feud and with a voice role on Invincible .
 Allen, who serves as founder, chairman and CEO of Allen Media Group, steers a portfolio that covers TV, film, streaming and broadcast with The Weather Channel, HBCUGO, TheGrio Television Network, BuzzFeed and HuffPost. He’s previously been honored by Harvard Business School, USC, UCLA and Syracuse University’s Newhouse School. Allen created and hosts the long-running Comics Unleashed with Byron Allen , currently celebrating its 20th anniversary and airing weeknights on CBS. 
 The Women’s Guild Cedars-Sinai fundraiser benefits the Women’s Guild Neurology Project and the Women’s Guild Distinguished Chair in Pediatrics at Cedars-Sinai’s newest expansion, Guerin Children’s. Women’s Guild has raised more than $70 million for the hospital. More info can be found here .
